name: LAMMPS
description: Builds LAMMPS stable_30Sep2026_update1 (lmp) into /opt/wise for the x86-64-v3 baseline with the image's MPI and OpenBLAS; KSPACE always uses the FFTW of the fftw Feature. Every bundled package is built except INTEL (needs the Intel compiler to pay off) and none that needs a third-party library or downloads code; packages backed by a Feature (PLUMED, H5MD, NETCDF) are added on request. The cuda variant adds KOKKOS (CUDA backend, cuFFT) and never the native GPU package.

variant.description: cpu: MPI + OPENMP package. cuda: additionally KOKKOS with the CUDA backend; requires the CUDA base image.

gpuArch.description: Kokkos GPU architecture of the cuda variant (Kokkos_ARCH_<value>), one per build; PTX is embedded too, so newer GPUs run after a JIT compile at first launch.

potentials.description: none: install no potential files. bundled: the potentials shipped in the LAMMPS source. all: also the large potential files of the enabled packages, downloaded from download.lammps.org and SHA256-checked by LAMMPS.

extraPackages.description: Packages to add, comma or space separated. A package backed by a Feature (PLUMED: plumed, H5MD: hdf5, NETCDF: netcdf) needs that Feature; INTEL is off by default and can be added for the cpu variant.

disablePackages.description: Bundled packages to leave out, comma or space separated. KSPACE cannot be left out.

cmakeArgs.description: Extra CMake arguments, space separated, applied last. All checks still apply.
